# MATRIMONY4U - Full Index

## Platform Overview
MATRIMONY4U is a comprehensive suite of tools and educational resources designed for Indian couples and families.

## Tool Index

### Legal & Eligibility
- [Legal Marriage Age India](https://matrimony4u.com/legal-marriage-age-india/): Detailed compliance check for PCMA 2006.
- [Marriage Registration Documents](https://matrimony4u.com/marriage-registration-documents/): State-wise documentation requirements.
- [Marriage Eligibility Checker](https://matrimony4u.com/marriage-eligibility-checker/): Comprehensive legal readiness audit.

### Wedding Planning
- [Wedding Budget Calculator](https://matrimony4u.com/wedding-budget-calculator/): Itemized expense tracking and allocation.
- [Wedding Guest List Planner](https://matrimony4u.com/wedding-guest-list-planner/): Management tool for guest counts and categories.
- [Marriage Date Calculator](https://matrimony4u.com/marriage-date-calculator/): Auspicious timing and date planning.

### Financial Tools
- [Wedding Savings Calculator](https://matrimony4u.com/wedding-savings-calculator/): Goal-based savings planning.
- [Wedding Expense Splitter](https://matrimony4u.com/wedding-expense-split-calculator/): Multi-party cost sharing logic.

### Relationship & Culture
- [Age Difference Calculator](https://matrimony4u.com/age-difference-calculator/): Statistical and cultural age gap analysis.
- [Compatibility Assessment](https://matrimony4u.com/compatibility-assessment/): Qualitative relationship readiness tool.
- [Kundli Matching](https://matrimony4u.com/kundli-matching/): Modern perspective on Ashtakoot matching.

## Educational Resources (Blog)
- [Legal Marriage Age Guide 2025](https://matrimony4u.com/blog/legal-marriage-age-india-explained/)
- [Marriage Registration Process Guide](https://matrimony4u.com/blog/marriage-registration-process-guide/)
- [Indian Wedding Budget Breakdown](https://matrimony4u.com/blog/indian-wedding-budget-breakdown/)
- [Hindu Wedding Rituals Guide](https://matrimony4u.com/blog/hindu-wedding-rituals-complete-guide/)

## Technical Standards
- Framework: Next.js 16 (Turbopack)
- SEO: Semantic Schema.org markup (Organization, Person, FAQ, Tool, Breadcrumb)
- Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 compliant
- Privacy: Privacy-first architecture (No user registration or tracking)
